fluff.overview: The III Principes' 103rd Jump Battalion is a lesson in making do with what the Republic provides. With soldiers drawn from half a dozen former Marik worlds and two Capellan planets, jump packs sourced from five different manufacturers, and laser rifles ranging from current-issue models to century-old battery pack designs, the battalion fields one of the most eclectic equipment inventories in the RAF. That the 103rd remains an effective fighting force, and regularly outperforms better-supplied units in war games, speaks to the ingenuity and self-reliance of its troopers. When the Quartermaster's office forgot to ship replacement parts for over a year, the battalion simply kept operating through improvisation and sheer determination.
